hints.title: Key Insight and Observation
hints.text: First verify the triangle inequality: the sum of the two shorter sides must exceed the longest side.

hints.title: Algorithmic Strategy and State
hints.text: Use the law of cosines to find each interior angle: cos(A) = (b^2 + c^2 - a^2) / (2 * b * c).

hints.title: Optimal Boundary and Processing
hints.text: Convert radians to degrees and return the three angles sorted in ascending order.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Direct trigonometric evaluation in constant time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Failing to check the triangle inequality leads to domain errors in acos.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Applies law of cosines with proper domain clamping in [-1, 1].
